content:
Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a prominent and rapidly growing player in the fine chemical and specialty chemical industries, headquartered in the Minhang District of Shanghai, China. Established with a vision to support scientific innovation and industrial advancement, the company has evolved into a comprehensive solution provider offering high-purity chemicals, analytical reagents, laboratory supplies, and custom synthesis services to a diverse range of clients, including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, and material science sectors. Meryer is recognized for its strong commitment to quality, technological innovation, and customer-centric service, adhering to strict international standards in product development, safety, and environmental sustainability.

Located in one of China’s most dynamic economic hubs, Meryer leverages its strategic position in Shanghai to foster collaboration with global research institutions and industrial partners. The company maintains an extensive inventory of over tens of thousands of chemical products, ranging from organic and inorganic compounds to catalysts, building blocks, and advanced materials. Backed by a professional team of chemists, engineers, and technical support specialists, Meryer ensures product authenticity, traceability, and reliability. In recent years, the company has invested heavily in research and development, automation, and digital supply chain platforms to enhance efficiency and meet the evolving needs of the global scientific community. With a mission to accelerate discovery and innovation, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. continues to expand its footprint both domestically and internationally, establishing itself as a trusted partner in the global chemical supply landscape.
